assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Continuous rhythm monitoring is indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other cardiac causes of cerebral hypoperfusion.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
